items.rss_summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." It’s all about oil. An escalation in US-Iran hostilities over the Strait of Hormuz puts energy markets on edge and raises fears of a return to all-out war. US Energy Secretary Chris Wright and Chevron CEO Mike Wirth discuss the push to boost oil production. Plus, conversations with BlackRock’s Gargi Chaudhuri, Rockefeller Capital Management CEO Greg Fleming and Ouster CEO Angus Pacala. (Source: Bloomberg)
